prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph. It is a birthday party invitation page in the clean contemporary style, executed impeccably: the tasteful modern e-invite done at the highest craft level.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, as regions of a web page. No navigation bar. Everything centred on a single column with very generous whitespace.

REGION 1, the top 45% of the screen: a soft, beautifully lit photograph of calm swimming-pool water in late afternoon sun, gentle ripples and warm highlights, no people and no faces, overlaid with a soft light scrim so text sits comfortably on it. Over the photograph, centred, the words HBD SUMMER PARTY in a refined modern serif, generously letterspaced, in warm off-white.

REGION 2, immediately below the photograph on an off-white ground: the date 08.28 at display scale in a light elegant serif, dark slate, with FRI 17:00 beneath it in small tracked capitals in a muted grey.

REGION 3: a thin hairline rule, then a tidy centred stack of details, each a small tracked capital label above a slightly larger value: the venue line in Korean 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현, and beneath it a short stack of what to bring.

REGION 4: a single soft-cornered pill button, muted dusty blue, centred, with a short label, sitting in generous whitespace.

REGION 5, the foot: a small muted gold ornament, then quiet space.

PALETTE, strictly: off-white, dark slate, muted dusty blue, soft muted gold, and the warm tones of the pool photograph. Calm, restrained, tasteful, generous whitespace, perfectly aligned, nothing loud.

No faces, no people, no logos, no prices, no testimonials, no invented claims, no text beyond what is specified.
